# Country scope. Valid landed non-rebel carrier for oe_global_kernel.
oe_gk_is_valid_carrier = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	num_locations > 0
}

# Any scope. True when BYZ's 1337 mainline scheduler (oe_clock_mainline) will NOT run this month.
oe_gk_mainline_absent = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
		c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = yes }
		NOT = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes }
	}
}

# Any scope. Quarter boundary months (1 / 4 / 7 / 10).
oe_gk_is_quarter_month = {
	OR = {
		current_month = 1
		current_month = 4
		current_month = 7
		current_month = 10
	}
}

# Any scope. Active 1337 challenge preset checks.
oe_gk_preset_is_standard = {
	has_global_variable = oe_v150_preset_standard
}

oe_gk_preset_is_multipolar = {
	has_global_variable = oe_v150_preset_multipolar
}

oe_gk_preset_is_hardcore = {
	has_global_variable = oe_v150_preset_hardcore
}

oe_gk_preset_is_elysia_fast = {
	has_global_variable = oe_v150_preset_elysia_fast
}

# Country scope (BYZ). At least one Tier-2 expansion theme zone is unlocked.
oe_v150_has_any_expansion_zone_unlocked = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			has_variable = oe_ir_italian_theme_done
			oe_italian_theme_creation_unlocked = yes
		}
		has_variable = oe_create_eastern_themes_done
		has_variable = oe_create_austrian_themes_done
		has_variable = oe_create_swiss_themes_done
	}
}

# Country scope (BYZ). At least one Italian area is eligible for Tier-2 expansion founding.
oe_v150_italy_area_creatable = {
	has_variable = oe_ir_italian_theme_done
	oe_italian_theme_creation_unlocked = yes
	any_owned_location = {
		region = region:italy_region
		is_province_capital = yes
		area = {
			NOT = { any_location_in_area = { oe_theme_location_occupied_trigger = yes } }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (BYZ). At least one Eastern expansion area is eligible.
oe_v150_eastern_area_creatable = {
	has_variable = oe_create_eastern_themes_done
	any_owned_location = {
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_region }
		OR = {
			area = area:jazira_area
			area = area:iraq_arabi_area
			area = area:levant_area
		}
		area = {
			NOT = { any_location_in_area = { oe_theme_location_occupied_trigger = yes } }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (BYZ). At least one Austrian expansion area is eligible.
oe_v150_austrian_area_creatable = {
	has_variable = oe_create_austrian_themes_done
	any_owned_location = {
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_region }
		OR = {
			area = area:transdanubia_area
			area = area:upper_austria_area
			area = area:austria_area
			area = area:styria_area
			area = area:salzburg_area
			area = area:carinthia_area
			area = area:tirol_area
		}
		area = {
			NOT = { any_location_in_area = { oe_theme_location_occupied_trigger = yes } }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (BYZ). At least one Swiss expansion area is eligible.
oe_v150_swiss_area_creatable = {
	has_variable = oe_create_swiss_themes_done
	any_owned_location = {
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_region }
		OR = {

		}
		area = {
			NOT = { any_location_in_area = { oe_theme_location_occupied_trigger = yes } }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (BYZ). Any unlocked Tier-2 expansion zone currently has a creatable theme area.
oe_v150_any_expansion_theme_creatable = {
	OR = {
		oe_v150_italy_area_creatable = yes
		oe_v150_eastern_area_creatable = yes
		oe_v150_austrian_area_creatable = yes
		oe_v150_swiss_area_creatable = yes
	}
}

# Country scope (BYZ). True when BYZ has an eligible small theme (<=15 locs, non-naval)
# and at least one loyal non-naval theme with < 3 absorbed regions to receive it.
oe_v150_any_consolidatable_theme_pair = {
	tag = BYZ
	is_rebel_country = no
	any_subject = {
		count >= 2
		oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
	}
	any_subject = {
		oe_t2_can_be_consolidated_recipient = yes
		oe_theme_jurisdiction_size <= 15
	}
	any_subject = {
		oe_theme_convertible_trigger = yes
		NOT = { is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_naval }
		oe_t2_receiver_under_region_cap = yes
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
		OR = {
			var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 2
			var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 3
		}
	}
}
